text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Drag coefficient varies with Reynolds number and the chosen body shape

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Original assigned log-log trend curves qualitatively follow textbook sphere, long-cylinder, and disk behavior; numerical knots are not digitized
experimental data and must not be used for design interpolation. Only the sphere’s low-Re24/Re asymptote is asserted quantitatively. Orientation, aspect
ratio, surface roughness, Mach number, and turbulence shift the coefficient and drag-crisis location.
